comment: One parent turn that fans out to two subagents, in the shape tui_gateway/server.py relays them: all six types on the PARENT session id, always stamped with session_id, and never `subagent.text` (the relay skips the child's reply body by name). The two agents are deliberately different: `sa-1` carries a real `subagent_id`, while the second carries none at all and must be identified by the synthetic composite `{parent_id or 'root'}:{task_index}:{goal}` — a fan-out where only some agents have ids is the case that collapses four agents into one row if identity is wrong. `tool_count` arrives as a float on one frame and an int on another because the gateway emits them interchangeably. `sa-ghost` sends a progress frame for an id nobody ever announced: it must be DISCARDED, not promoted into a headless row with no goal and no way to finish. The second agent ends with `status: 'timeout'`, which is the trap — desktop's status mapper falls through anything unrecognised to `running`, so its timed-out agents never become terminal, never prune and spin forever; here `subagent.complete` is terminal by event type and `timeout` maps to `failed`. message.complete then ends the parent turn with one running agent left over, which is the case turn end must NOT clear.
